description: This file contains common utility functions, classes, macros, and constants used in the ANGLE project, including memory management helpers, array utilities, string formatting, and graphics format definitions.

classes.name: NonCopyable
classes.description: A helper class to disallow copy and assignment operators, used as a base class for non-copyable objects.

classes.name: WrappedArray
classes.description: A final class template that manages a non-copyable array of elements, providing access to the array and its size.

methods.name: ArraySize
methods.description: Returns the size of a statically sized array.

methods.name: WrappedArray
methods.description: Constructors for managing array data, including from a C-style array or pointer with size.

methods.name: SafeRelease
methods.description: Releases COM resources or similar, safely setting the resource to nullptr.

methods.name: SafeDelete
methods.description: Deletes a pointer and sets it to nullptr.

methods.name: SafeDeleteContainer
methods.description: Deletes all elements in a container and clears it.

methods.name: SafeDeleteArray
methods.description: Deletes a dynamically allocated array and sets pointer to nullptr.

methods.name: StructLessThan
methods.description: Compares two structs byte-wise to determine if one is less than the other.

methods.name: StructEquals
methods.description: Checks if two structs are byte-wise equal.

methods.name: IsMaskFlagSet
methods.description: Checks if specific bits are set in a mask.

methods.name: MakeStaticString
methods.description: Returns a static C-string for a given std::string, storing it in a static set to avoid destruction at exit.

methods.name: ArrayString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of an array index based on an unsigned int.

methods.name: ArrayIndexString
methods.description: Returns a string with reversed indices from a vector of unsigned ints.

methods.name: Str
methods.description: Converts an integer to a string.

methods.name: FormatStringIntoVector
methods.description: Formats a string into a vector of characters using printf-style formatting.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a value to its string representation using stringstream.
